milestones.title: M1 - Provider foundation
milestones.description: Root Framework module, isolated registries/mocks, schema and docs tooling, mandatory CI and reproducible build commands exist. No live feature qualification is claimed.

milestones.title: M2 - Portable authenticated directory foundation
milestones.description: Portable LDAP, verified TLS, Kerberos CBT, SASL signing/sealing, outcome contracts, client integration and Linux/Windows lab connectivity pass their acceptance gates.

milestones.title: M3 - Four-surface reference slice
milestones.description: OU and user resource/data/list lifecycles and the unlock action have unit, docs/examples and applicable eight-cell live evidence; no-change and failure recovery are demonstrated.

milestones.title: M4 - Core directory management
milestones.description: Core objects, supported managed service accounts, account settings and individual relationships meet the same delivery bar.

milestones.title: M5 - Policies and access control
milestones.description: Password, authentication, central access, claims and resource property families pass descriptor/condition, privilege and relationship qualification.

milestones.title: M6 - Topology and observations
milestones.description: Topology, adopted settings, discovery and portable diagnostics cover the applicable client/server matrix without incomplete-read data loss.

milestones.title: M7 - Advanced directory actions
milestones.description: Explicitly acknowledged high-impact actions are qualified in isolated/restorable fixtures with outcome and recovery evidence.

milestones.title: M8 - Provider release qualification
milestones.description: All included surfaces, examples/templates, dependency and evidence audits, release artifacts and security checks pass; macOS live evidence remains explicitly unclaimed.
